pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Flank patches exhibit larger surface area and irregular geometric bounds compared to the smaller, more compact patches on the lower limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial network forming a topological graph. Node junctions primarily show tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the flank, maintaining connectivity between all observed nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane exhibits a serrated 1D silhouette with regular, low-amplitude oscillations against the background along the visible upper neck and shoulder ridge.
